d: Job Title: Admin Assistant (Bookkeeping & Inventory Management)

We are seeking a highly detail-oriented and proactive Admin Assistant to support the financial and operational backbone of a creative, service-driven business. This role plays a critical part in maintaining accuracy across bookkeeping, payroll, inventory tracking, and vendor management while ensuring day-to-day operations remain organized, efficient, and reliable.

This is a hands-on, execution-focused role ideal for someone who enjoys working with systems, numbers, documentation, and operational processes. The ideal candidate is highly organized, dependable, and capable of independently managing multiple responsibilities in a remote environment.

You will help create operational clarity by ensuring financial records, inventory systems, vendor relationships, and reporting processes are consistently maintained with precision and professionalism.
q: Proven experience in bookkeeping, accounting support, or financial administration
Hands-on experience with inventory management and vendor coordination
Strong proficiency with QuickBooks, Square, or similar accounting/payment systems
Advanced Microsoft Excel or Google Sheets skills for reporting, analysis, and tracking
Excellent written and verbal communication skills
Ability to prioritize tasks and manage workflows independently
Previous experience supporting small businesses, creative agencies, or service-based businesses
Familiarity with U.S. small business tax processes and compliance requirements
Experience with inventory management systems and operational reporting
Exposure to payroll processing and vendor contract management
Experience creating operational SOPs or process documentation
Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, Business Administration, or a related field preferred
Relevant certifications or bookkeeping/accounting training are a plus
What Does a Typical Day Look Like?
An Admin Assistant in this role focuses on maintaining operational accuracy and supporting efficient business workflows. You will:
Manage and reconcile financial transactions and bookkeeping records
Process payroll-related tasks and maintain compliance documentation
Monitor inventory levels and coordinate restocking activities
Communicate with vendors and manage payment tracking
Update spreadsheets, reports, and operational documentation
Support process organization and improve administrative efficiency
In essence: you ensure financial accuracy, operational consistency, and organized systems that help the business run smoothly every day.
Accuracy and timeliness of bookkeeping and payroll processing
Compliance with reporting and documentation requirements
Organization and reliability of operational systems and records
Timely completion of administrative and financial workflows
Practical Assessment (Bookkeeping or Inventory Management Scenario)
r: Manage daily bookkeeping activities and maintain organized, accurate financial records
Process invoices, expenses, reconciliations, and transaction tracking
Support payroll calculations and ensure timely and accurate payment processing
Prepare and organize required financial and tax documentation
Assist in maintaining compliance with financial processes and reporting standards
Support implementation and optimization of accounting systems and workflows
Maintain organized digital records for financial reporting and audit readiness
Monitor inventory levels, stock movement, and usage trends
Coordinate inventory ordering and restocking processes
Maintain accurate inventory tracking systems and documentation
Identify shortages, overstocking, or inefficiencies and proactively recommend solutions
Generate inventory reports and cost tracking summaries as needed
Build and maintain professional vendor relationships
Track vendor invoices, contracts, payment schedules, and obligations
Execute expense management and vendor optimization initiatives
Coordinate vendor communications regarding orders, billing, or service issues
Support cost control and operational efficiency efforts
Maintain organized documentation across bookkeeping, inventory, and vendor systems
Create and update spreadsheets, trackers, and operational reports
Support internal process consistency and administrative workflows
Ensure data accuracy across reports, systems, and operational records
Assist leadership with administrative and operational support tasks as needed
What Makes You a Strong Fit
Highly detail-oriented with strong accuracy and organizational discipline
Reliable, proactive, and comfortable working independently in a remote environment
Strong problem-solving mindset with the ability to manage multiple responsibilities calmly
Enjoys creating structure, maintaining systems, and improving operational processes
Communicates professionally and effectively with vendors and internal stakeholders
Process-driven with strong ownership and follow-through

d: Visa is a world leader in payments technology, facilitating transactions between consumers, merchants, financial institutions and government entities across more than 200 countries and territories, dedicated to uplifting everyone, everywhere by being the best way to pay and be paid.
At Visa, you'll have the opportunity to create impact at scale — tackling meaningful challenges, growing your skills and seeing your contributions impact lives around the world.
Join Visa and do work that matters – to you, to your community, and to the world. Progress starts with you.

The Director, Client Success and Business Planning is a lead individual contributor responsible for managing the holistic post-sale Client Services relationship for assigned clients and delivering operational solutions to support business growth. This role acts as a trusted client advocate, proactively enabling new capabilities, supporting geographic expansion, and promoting product adoption. The Director provides strategic guidance and thought leadership during solution development to ensure exceptional client service, requiring professionalism and strong interpersonal skills to influence and manage relationships with internal and client stakeholders.

Lead portfolio strategy, business planning, and operational execution across the client portfolio, partnering with senior stakeholders to translate strategic priorities into actionable plans, drive performance outcomes, and support sustainable business growth. This role will serve as a key advisor to leadership on portfolio health, investment priorities, organizational effectiveness, and long-term business objectives.

This position is at the forefront of Visa’s Client Success transformation, partnering closely with key clients to maximize benefits realization and value from Visa products by optimizing performance. Working with Account Team members from Sales and Product, the Director drives Client Success outcomes aligned with Visa’s business agenda and defines client support and service implementation strategies that deliver value and support Visa’s strategy. The Director represents the client’s voice on operational initiatives and issues with internal functional and regional partners.
This role serves as a functional specialist, located in [CEMEA/KSA] and reporting to KBO CSM lead.
All roles require digital fluency, including the ability to work with emerging technologies such as Generative AI tools (e.g. ChatGPT, Microsoft Copilot, Claude) to support everyday work.
q: 12 or more years of work experience with a Bachelor’s Degree or at least 10 years of work experience with an Advanced Degree (e.g. Masters/ MBA/JD/MD) or at least 3 years of work experience with a PhD
Experience analyzing data and translating findings into actionable business solutions.
Experience in communicating complex technical terms and processes in business language tailored to client.
Experience prioritizing and multi-tasking under deadlines.
Experience with Artificial Intelligence (AI) concepts and applications to create value for Visa and its clients.
Experience representing technical and business issues and solutions to influence audiences at multiple levels of an organization, including senior executives.
Experience in the payment industry, including trends, threats, competitors, and regulatory environments.
Experience leading cross-functional team members through high-impact, complex business issues.
Certifications or qualifications in Client/Customer Success, project management, or related areas.
Advanced proficiency in building client relationships, becoming customer centric, success planning, client engagement, proactiveness, and critical thinking.
12 or more years of work experience with a bachelor’s degree or 8-10 years of experience with an Advanced Degree (e.g. Masters, MBA, JD, MD) or 6+ years of work experience with a PhD
Able to communicate complex technical terms and/or processes in business language tailored to client.
Experience developing and delivering client education and training materials.
Experience leading implementation of strategic initiatives in support of transformation programs.
Experience collaborating with global, regional, and in-market teams to deliver consistent operational relationship experiences.

Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability or protected veteran status. Visa will also consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with EEOC guidelines and applicable local law.
r: Drive portfolio governance and performance tracking, including Signed Not Live (SNL) pipeline oversight, readiness case management, risk identification, and escalation of off-track opportunities.
Support business planning and reporting processes, including OKR tracking, performance scorecards, reporting packs, and preparation for leadership reviews and business cadences.

Coordinate cross-functional execution of strategic priorities, partnering with CSMs, product teams, readiness teams, and sales stakeholders to drive accountability, remove blockers, and improve operational outcomes.

Provide analytical and operational support to the leadership team, delivering insights, deep-dive analysis, and recommendations to improve activation, revenue realization, and overall business performance.
Oversee implementation of new Visa products by coordinating Client and Visa teams to expedite readiness and maximize adoption.
Build and sustain trusted client advocate status by executing Client Success Plans and tracking client-specific outcomes, including product adoption and performance.
Drive initiatives to improve client adoption of products and use of Visa’s self-service tools.
Provide thought leadership on market trends, payment processing, Visa solutions, and technologies to enhance the Client experience and generate new sales leads.
Establish working relationships with Client Services and cross-functional subject matter experts to resolve complex client issues and optimize performance.
Develop client education and training materials to communicate new Visa Rules, mandates, and business enhancement releases.
Lead periodic operational reviews with clients and Visa stakeholders.
Act as escalation point for significant issues and major incident/crisis responses.
Support cross-functional initiatives to improve the Client experience, incorporating automated solutions for efficiency and productivity.
Proactively identify and drive opportunities to optimize client performance by monitoring client health and liaising with specialist Visa teams.
Coordinate and collaborate with global, regional, and in-market Client Success team members to maintain a continuous 360-degree view of the Client.
Lead implementation of key strategic initiatives in support of global Client Success transformation.
Visa requires at least 3 days in office, expectations of these days will be confirmed by your Hiring Manager.

d: Four Seasons is powered by our people. We are a collective of individuals who crave to become better, to push ourselves to new heights and to treat each other as we wish to be treated in return. Our team members around the world create amazing experiences for our guests, residents, and partners through a commitment to luxury with genuine heart. We know that the best way to enable our people to deliver these exceptional guest experiences is through a world-class employee experience and company culture.

At Four Seasons, we believe in recognizing a familiar face, welcoming a new one and treating everyone we meet the way we would want to be treated ourselves. Whether you work with us, stay with us, live with us or discover with us, we believe our purpose is to create impressions that will stay with you for a lifetime. It comes from our belief that life is richer when we truly connect to the people and the world around us.

On an exclusive island in the heart of the Kingdom’s capital, Four Seasons Hotel Bahrain Bay, with its unique architecture, has become an iconic landmark that soars as a destination in its own right, combining the best of a beach holiday and an urban getaway.

We are seeking a passionate and talented Junior Sous Chef to join our dynamic culinary team. The ideal candidate will assist in leading kitchen operations, ensuring the highest standards of quality, presentation, and consistency in line with Four Seasons’ luxury standards.
q: Minimum 2–3 years of culinary experience, preferably in a luxury hotel or fine dining environment.
Strong knowledge of international cuisine and modern cooking techniques.
Ability to work under pressure and maintain high standards.
Culinary degree or equivalent certification is preferred.
r: Support the Sous Chef in managing daily kitchen operations.
Supervise and guide junior team members to maintain quality and efficiency.
Ensure all dishes meet Four Seasons’ standards for taste, presentation, and hygiene.
Assist in menu planning, costing, and inventory control.
Maintain compliance with health, safety, and sanitation regulations.
Foster a positive and collaborative work environment.
